hints.title: Capacity Bound
hints.text: Each query allows choosing any subset of indices in its interval [l, r] to decrement by 1. Therefore, index i can be decremented at most as many times as the total number of queries covering index i.

hints.title: Coverage Computation
hints.text: Use a difference array diff of size n + 1. For each query [l, r], add 1 to diff[l] and subtract 1 from diff[r + 1].

hints.title: Feasibility Check
hints.text: Accumulate prefix sums across diff to obtain coverage count at each index i. If nums[i] <= coverage[i] for all i, return true, otherwise false.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Applies difference array marking for each query range in O(1) time followed by linear prefix sum validation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Updating array cells explicitly for every query takes O(n * q) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for difference array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models interval decrement capacity using a difference array and validates whether each element is <= coverage capacity.
